suspects.message_pass: Lender cash-like incentive is $2,500 or less and within allowable limits.
suspects.message_fail: Lender gave borrower a cash-like incentive exceeding $2,500 — interested party contribution requirement violated.

suspects.message_pass: Premium pricing credit does not exceed closing costs and was not applied to down payment
suspects.message_fail: Premium pricing credit was applied to down payment and/or exceeded the amount needed to offset closing costs

suspects.message_pass: ATR covered loan points and fees percentage is at or below the applicable limit
suspects.message_fail: ATR covered loan points and fees exceed 3% of loan amount (or applicable tiered limit for loans under $100,000) -- QM eligibility at risk

suspects.message_pass: Non-mortgage charge-off account balance does not exceed $2,000; payoff requirement not triggered.
suspects.message_fail: Non-mortgage charge-off account amount exceeds $2,000 and was not paid in full at or prior to closing.

suspects.message_pass: Non-mortgage collection account balance does not exceed $2000; payoff requirement not triggered.
suspects.message_fail: Non-mortgage collection account balance exceeds $2000 and was not paid in full at or prior to closing.

suspects.message_pass: Founder salary is 10% or less of annual company burn — within acceptable limit.
suspects.message_fail: Founder salary exceeds 10% of annual company burn — defect condition triggered.

suspects.message_pass: Private stock income does not exceed the previous capital gains sale amount, or has been properly reduced per guidelines for 2 or more stock sales.
suspects.message_fail: Private stock income exceeds the previous capital gains sale amount and has not been reduced per guidelines for a 2 or more stock sale -- income calculation is non-compliant.

suspects.message_pass: SFHDF fee charged to borrower does not exceed actual costs plus life-of-loan monitoring fee
suspects.message_fail: SFHDF fee charged to borrower exceeds actual costs plus life-of-loan monitoring fee -- overcharge amount is positive

suspects.message_pass: LCO refi LTV is at or below 95%; eligibility requirements check not triggered by LTV threshold.
suspects.message_fail: LCO refi LTV exceeds 95% -- all eligibility requirements for this LTV tier must be verified and documented; defect flagged.

suspects.message_pass: Co-op single entity stock/share ownership is 20% or less -- within allowable limit.
suspects.message_fail: CRITICAL: Co-op project has a single entity owning more than 20% of the corporation's stock/shares (and related occupancy rights) -- project is ineligible.

suspects.message_pass: LTV is at or below 95%; homeownership education requirement threshold not triggered by LTV alone.
suspects.message_fail: LTV exceeds 95% on a purchase transaction (or borrower uses non-traditional credit) and homeownership education requirements have not been met.

suspects.message_pass: AUS Refer: Sales price does not exceed NOV, or verified funds cover the difference plus closing costs.
suspects.message_fail: AUS Refer: Sales price exceeds NOV and verified funds covering the difference plus closing costs are not documented.

suspects.message_pass: Sales price does not exceed VA Notice of Reasonable Value (NOV).
suspects.message_fail: Sales price exceeds VA Notice of Reasonable Value (NOV) and/or documentation that HAP funds are a grant is not provided.

suspects.message_pass: Unknown deposit amount does not exceed 50% of qualifying income, or source is documented and account reduced as required.
suspects.message_fail: Unknown deposit exceeds 50% of qualifying income and source is not documented and/or account has not been reduced — CRITICAL defect.

suspects.message_pass: Rent credit to sale price does not exceed the difference between rent paid and market rent, and rent-sale agreement is present.
suspects.message_fail: CRITICAL: Rent credited to sale price either lacks a rent-sale agreement or the credit amount exceeds the difference between rent paid and market rent -- defect flagged per O-FRD-15502.

suspects.message_pass: Escrow repair cost is 10% or less of loan amount; borrower self-completion escrow within allowable limit.
suspects.message_fail: Escrow repair cost exceeds 10% of loan amount on a borrower self-completion escrow; ability documentation must be in file but is missing.

suspects.message_pass: Lender credit does not exceed total closing costs, or excess was properly reduced/applied as principal curtailment
suspects.message_fail: Lender credit exceeds closing costs and no reduction or principal curtailment was applied -- defect condition present

suspects.message_pass: Non-medical, non-mortgage collection total balance is below $1,000 and no single account is $250 or more -- collections requirement satisfied.
suspects.message_fail: Non-medical, non-mortgage collection account(s) have a single balance of $250 or more OR total balances exceed $1,000 and are not paid in full -- defect flagged.

suspects.message_pass: DTI is at or below 36%; no elevated-DTI credit and reserve exception required.
suspects.message_fail: DTI exceeds 36% and borrower does not meet the required credit and reserve compensating requirements; loan should not have been approved as submitted.

suspects.message_pass: Income used for qualifying equals or does not exceed the lower of historical capital gains/interest/dividend income amounts.
suspects.message_fail: Capital gains, interest, or dividend income is below historical levels and the lower (reduced) amount was not used for qualifying -- defect threshold unspecified; SME input required.

suspects.message_pass: Post-close DTI does not exceed allowable limit based on post-close credit report review.
suspects.message_fail: CRITICAL: DTI has increased beyond the allowable limit due to new or increased payments identified on the post-close review credit report.

suspects.message_pass: Adjusted annual household income does not exceed the applicable moderate income program limit
suspects.message_fail: Adjusted annual household income exceeds the applicable moderate income program limit -- loan is ineligible for this program

suspects.message_pass: Employment history is 2 or more years; income type acceptability check for short-tenure window does not apply.
suspects.message_fail: Employment history is more than 1 year but less than 2 years; income type used is unacceptable for this employment tenure band.

suspects.message_pass: Secondary employment gap in last 12 months is 1 month or less, or employment is designated as seasonal.
suspects.message_fail: Secondary employment has a gap exceeding 1 month within the last 12 months and employment type is not changed to seasonal -- defect condition met.

suspects.message_pass: SSI gross-up percentage is 15% or less; within allowable limit.
suspects.message_fail: SSI gross-up percentage exceeds 15% without documentation supporting nontaxable status; defect flagged.

suspects.message_pass: Income fluctuation is 30% or less; no additional stability analysis required.
suspects.message_fail: Income fluctuation exceeds 30% and no additional stability analysis or supporting documentation is present in the file.

suspects.message_pass: Borrower ownership interest is 25% or greater; GUS employment type selection is consistent.
suspects.message_fail: GUS indicates 'Business Owner' or 'Self-Employed' but borrower ownership interest is less than 25% -- employment type selection is inconsistent.

suspects.message_pass: Schedule C 1099 expenses are 5% or less of gross receipts/sales after deducting non-cash expenses
suspects.message_fail: Schedule C 1099 expenses exceed 5% of gross receipts or sales after deducting non-cash expenses -- income calculation defect

suspects.message_pass: Variable trust income has been received for 2 or more years; income may be used without requiring offsetting positive factors.
suspects.message_fail: Variable trust income received for at least 1 year but less than 2 years was used in qualifying without documented offsetting positive factors; this is a Major defect.

suspects.message_pass: Co-Op master policy deductible is 5% or less; no area-peril deductible issue flagged.
suspects.message_fail: Co-Op master policy deductible exceeds 5% due to area peril and HO-6 policy cannot meet the deductible gap -- CRITICAL insurance defect.

suspects.message_pass: SFHDF fee charged to borrower does not exceed actual costs plus life-of-loan monitoring fee
suspects.message_fail: SFHDF fee charged to borrower exceeds actual costs plus life-of-loan monitoring fee -- defect condition met

suspects.message_pass: Insurance coverage meets minimum requirement (at least 80% of replacement cost or lesser of 100% replacement cost / UPB)
suspects.message_fail: Insurance coverage is below required minimum: must be the lesser of 100% replacement cost or UPB, and at least 80% of replacement cost

suspects.message_pass: LTV is at or below 80%; MI not required, or MI from approved insurer at required coverage level is present.
suspects.message_fail: LTV exceeds 80% but MI from an approved insurer at the required coverage level is absent or insufficient.

suspects.message_pass: LTV is at or below 80%; MI requirement does not apply.
suspects.message_fail: LTV exceeds 80% but MI from an approved insurer at the required coverage level is not present — defect flagged.

suspects.message_pass: Materials advance does not exceed 50% of cost of materials, or borrower is acting as own contractor -- CHOICERenovation requirement met.
suspects.message_fail: CRITICAL: Materials advance exceeds 50% of cost of materials and borrower is not acting as own contractor -- CHOICERenovation policy violation.

suspects.message_pass: Construction completion is 90% or greater; floor plan, plot plan, and size/finish exhibits requirement does not apply.
suspects.message_fail: Construction is less than 90% complete; floor plan, plot plan, and size/finish exhibits must be documented in the file but are not present.

suspects.message_pass: DTI ratio does not exceed 41%; no debt ratio waiver required for GUS refer/manual UW scenario.
suspects.message_fail: DTI ratio exceeds 41% on a GUS refer/manual UW loan; approved debt ratio waiver must be present in the file but is missing.

suspects.message_pass: Appraisal is 4 months old or less at closing, or a Form 1004D reinspection is present — no staleness defect.
suspects.message_fail: Appraisal is over 4 months (>122 days) but under 12 months old at closing and no Form 1004D reinspection is documented — reinspection required.

suspects.message_pass: HOA commercial parking lease income is 10% or less of budgeted income -- within acceptable limit.
suspects.message_fail: HOA commercial parking lease income exceeds 10% of budgeted income -- condo project eligibility defect.

suspects.message_pass: Condo HOA litigation amount does not exceed 10% of project funded reserves and is not otherwise unallowable.
suspects.message_fail: Condo HOA litigation amount exceeds 10% of project funded reserves or is unallowable under applicable laws and regulations -- condo project eligibility defect.

suspects.message_pass: VA ext-only/desktop appraisal with down payment less than 20% has case unassigned for 7 or more business days — meets minimum assignment seasoning requirement.
suspects.message_fail: VA ext-only/desktop appraisal with down payment less than 20% has case unassigned for fewer than 7 business days — fails minimum assignment seasoning requirement.

suspects.message_pass: Full interior appraisal used; purchase price does not exceed conforming loan limit or appraisal type is appropriate.
suspects.message_fail: CRITICAL: Exterior-only or desktop appraisal was used but the purchase price exceeds the conforming loan limit — a full interior appraisal is required.

suspects.message_pass: DTI is at or below 41%; no UW justification required for DTI alone.
suspects.message_fail: DTI exceeds 41% and/or residual income is below VA minimum; UW justification for approval not documented -- defect flagged.

suspects.message_pass: LTV is at or below 95%; homeownership education requirement trigger does not apply on LTV basis alone.
suspects.message_fail: CRITICAL: LTV exceeds 95% on a purchase transaction – homeownership education requirements must be met and documented in the file.

suspects.message_pass: LTV is at or below 80%; non-occupant co-borrower down payment source restriction does not apply.
suspects.message_fail: CRITICAL: Manual UW loan with non-occupant and occupying borrower has LTV >80% — the 5% minimum down payment must come entirely from the occupying borrower's own funds; donated/gift funds are ineligible at this LTV.
